description: Tasmania Higher Mass Limits (HML) Approved Network is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Department of State Growth, TAS. Shows roads in 3 categories: approved (green), conditionally approved (orange) and restricted (red). Tasmania's HML network does not allow access for: (1) Truck and dog trailer combinations - this is provided via the Increased Mass Limit (IML) network. Coverage is Tasmania; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-08-01. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
